title: Uniform training-only numerical refinement of saved application fits
status: Post-result numerical validation; no new data, seeds, fitted families or test-score selection
prediction_scope: Every primary CV/full/area-out task, plus every existing wide-bound CV task for LD only
bootstrap_scope: All199 existing bootstrap tasks for each primary variant, with the identical policy; launch after prediction-scope validation
bounds_policy: Use each task’s original primary or existing wide LD box exactly; Gaussian bounds remain exactly the frozen control bounds
initialization: Every distinct finite saved retained/optimizer endpoint, including failed optimizer endpoints; no new random seeds or partitions
nested_policy: Retain and refine the newly fitted common-shape point embedded in full LD; count dependency and verify nested training likelihood
selection: Highest finite training likelihood; within1e-12 choose lower original-coordinate projected gradient, then larger training likelihood, then earlier candidate
evaluation: Only after checkpointing selected parameters; original ALR or original crab millimetres, with exact conditional marginal/Jacobian
